name: Vitals Dashboard
description: Doctor selects one of their attended patients, then sees a comprehensive vitals dashboard with KPI metrics, trend charts, and a full server-side paginated data table.

intent_examples: Display heart rate and sleep data
when_to_use: Doctor wants to view a patient's vitals overview or dashboard
Doctor asks for heart rate, blood pressure, steps, or sleep data
Doctor wants to see vitals trends or charts
Doctor wants to browse all of a patient's vitals records
when_not_to_use: User wants to record or create new vitals entries
User wants to update or delete a vitals entry
Patient wants to view their own vitals (use the patient portal instead)

introduction: I'll pull up the vitals dashboard. First, select a patient you've attended.

workflow_steps.name: Resolve Practitioner
workflow_steps.description: Silently fetches the current doctor's Practitioner record to extract practitioner_id for use in subsequent steps.

workflow_steps.name: Select Patient
workflow_steps.description: Search the doctor's own attended-patient roster (derived from their appointments) and pick one.

context_resolvers.description: Loads every appointment for this practitioner (tenant-scoped) so the patient roster can be derived client-side.

workflow_steps.name: Vitals Dashboard
workflow_steps.description: Renders KPI metrics, trend charts, and a server-side paginated table of the selected patient's vitals records.
